summary:
Backend-only test of POST /api/leads email pipeline via the Emergent-managed email proxy. Created 2 test leads (one with customer email delivered@resend.dev, one without email) against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Both leads returned 200 with status=Pending and a valid uuid id. Backend logs confirm 'Business notification sent for lead ' for BOTH leads and 'Customer confirmation sent for lead ' for the email-bearing lead, with no 'Failed to send' errors for our lead ids. Also imported server and called send_email(to='delivered@resend.dev', subject='QA test', html='...
') directly — returned a non-null string id, confirming the proxy at POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send accepts the payload and is not mocked. 4/4 pytest tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking, just deprecation).
send_lead_emails is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task; failures are logged but never surfaced. Consider a lightweight DB flag (email_sent: bool) so admins can retry/verify from the panel.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' but allow_credentials=True is set — browsers will reject credentialed requests when origin is '*'. Set explicit origins in .env for production.
Stale RESEND_API_KEY / SENDER_EMAIL / BUSINESS_EMAIL keys remain in backend/.env after migration; safe to remove to avoid confusion.
test_credentials: Customer email used in tests: delivered@resend.dev (safe sink). Owner emails delivered to configured OWNER_EMAIL=Sujacontera@gmail.com by design (2 real emails sent as required).
seed_data_creation: 2 test leads inserted into MongoDB 'leads' collection (names prefixed 'TEST QA'). Not auto-cleaned — the /api/admin/leads UI can remove them; kept per instruction not to modify sent emails/history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email path is live and wired to Emergent proxy. Owner (Sujacontera@gmail.com) will receive real emails on every POST /api/leads — throttle test volume. To verify without spamming, either (a) unset OWNER_EMAIL in a scratch env, or (b) grep backend logs for 'Business notification sent for lead <id>'. The direct helper test in test_email_leads.py::test_send_email_helper_direct is the cheapest smoke test.
